name: Dogz 3D
summary: Dogz 3D is a pet simulation game released in 2007, where players can adopt and care for their own virtual puppy. They can feed, clean, and play with their pet while making sure it stays happy and healthy. The game features 3D graphics, multiple dog breeds, and different locations to explore. It also includes fun mini-games, such as frisbee, swimming, and tug-of-war, offering an enjoyable experience for dog lovers.
